why: Live numbers (meters, stats, sparklines, counts) differ from the picture by design; threshold is 0.01 because the text of problem lines can wrap by a few pixels in WebKit. The preview mock has other names, order and problem wording than the picture. The mockup sidebar also draws Projects, which the spec (WO-2.2) leaves out until WO-7.5: one 29px row shifts the nav.
The app adds a count of 0 and the longer copy from WO-3.1b. The mockup sidebar also draws Projects, which the spec (WO-2.2) leaves out until WO-7.5: one 29px row shifts the nav.
The app hides the meters while the machine is stopped (live state). The mockup sidebar also draws Projects, which the spec (WO-2.2) leaves out until WO-7.5: one 29px row shifts the nav.
Log lines carry the time of the run and the facts line carries relative times.  The mockup sidebar also draws Projects, which the spec (WO-2.2) leaves out until WO-7.5: one 29px row shifts the nav.
